narr: A low pressure lifting through the region on the 28th resulted in strong thunderstorms that produced severe hail, strong winds, and flooding rainfall.
ev: An approximate 75-foot section of the paved trail in Pictured Rocks National Lakeshore Park was washed out the evening of April 28th from recent heavy rainfall and seasonal snow melt. Time estimated from radar.
